MIND. [1] [Act. r.]
Sensation as if a heavy black cloud had settled all over her, and enveloped her head, so that all was darkness and confusion, while, at the same time, it weighed like lead on her head.
Thinks she is going crazy.
Often started by illusion of a mouse running from under her chair.
Imagines strange objects about bed, as rats, sheep, etc. θ Delirium tremens.
Delirium with great headache. θ Puerperal fever.
Fear of death ; fears those in house will kill him ; saw wires encaging him ; visions of rats and of strange objects. θ Delirium tremens.
Mania following disappearance of neuralgia.
Puerperal mania.
Incessant talking, changing from one subject to another. θ Delirium tremens.
Frequent sighs and ejaculations. θ Mental disorder.
Feels grieved and troubled, with sighing ; next day a feeling of tremulous joy, with mirthfullness, playfulness and clear intellect.
Miserable dejected feeling ; anxious, weeping.
Mental depression, with suicidal mood ; also after checked neuralgia.
Great melancholy with sleeplessness.
Apprehensive and sleepless. θ Pregnancy.
Fears she will become crazy, with headache on vertex.
Fear of death.
Indifferent, taciturn, takes no interest in household matters. θ Mental disorder.
Irritable ; the least thing that goes wrong makes her angry.
Suspicious of everything, would not take medicine if she knew it. θ Mental disorder.
Restless and impatient, can read only a few minutes, must get up and walk about, yet soon tires.
Headache of students.
Mental emotions cause : amenorrhœa ; suppression of lochia.
Mind disturbed by disappointed love, business failures.
Feels faint at epigastrium when meeting a friend.
After fright : threatened abortion.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Act. r.]
Dizzy on rising in morning, with pain over eyes ; faintness, nausea and occasional vomiting. θ In mental diseases.
Fainting fits generally with some uterine affection.
Sensation as if a heavy black cloud had settled all over her and enveloped her head, so that all was darkness and confusion. θ Mental disorder.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Act. r.]
Rush of blood to head, brain feels too large for cranium ; after suppressed uterine discharges or suddenly ceasing neuralgic pains.
Great pain in head and eyeballs, increased by slightest movement of head or eyeballs. θ Meningitis.
Headache down to nose.
Headache every day at same hour.
Severe pain in right side of head, back of orbit. θ After pains.
Aching and shooting pains in vertex, occiput, left temple, eye and ear ; < lying down ; hysterical crying.
Brain as if too large ; pressing from within outward.
Head feels as if pounded, full ; as if too large. θ Intermittent.
Top of head feels as if it would fly off, < going up-stairs ; declares she will go crazy.
Intense pain as if a ball had been driven from neck to vertex, < at every throb of heart.
Aching pain in head, particularly at occiput, only indoors ; < in afternoon and still more in evening, disappearing entirely at 9 P. M. after a walk in open air.
Great pain in head, back and limbs.
Pain over and in eyes, extending along back to occiput.
Excruciating pain in forehead, eyeballs and temples, with cold forehead on waking, 2 A. M.
Pain in forehead, temple and vertex, with fulness, throbbing and heat.
Dull pain in occiput, with shooting down back of neck.
Headache better in open air.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Act. r.]
Sensation as if vertex opened and let in cold air. θ Climaxis.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Act. r.]
Peculiar wild look out of eyes. θ Delirium tremens.
Eyes expressionless. θ Cholera.
Dark spots before eyes.
Pupils dilated. θ Delirium.
Ulcerated cornea, with sharp pains through eye into head.
Eyes congested during headache.
Pain in centre of eyeballs, and also a sensation as if pain was situated between eyeball and orbital plate of parietal bone ; more severe in morning, < on going up-stairs.
Pain over eyes extending to occiput.
Ciliary neuralgia ; aching pains in eyeballs or in temples, extending to eyes, so severe, especially at night, it seemed as if patient would go crazy.
Blisters on eyelids.
Severe pains darting into left eye ; feels as if needles were run into eyeball through cornea ; < on closing eyes ; sleepy, but cannot sleep on this account. θ Neuralgia.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Act. r.]
Buzzing in ears. θ Puerperal fever.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Act. r.]
Face bluish. θ Puerperal fever.
Wild, fearful expression. θ Delirium tremens.
Forehead feels cold ; deadly pale.
Neuralgia affecting malar bone, pain goes off at night, reappears next day.
Suddenly very faint, face became ashy white, weakness so great that she believed she was dying. θ Puerperal fever.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Act. r.]
Jaw sunken. θ Typhus.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Act. r.]
Great thirst. θ Puerperal fever.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Act. r.]
Eructations, with nausea, vomiting and headache, more in women.
Nausea, retching, dilated pupils, tremor of limbs. θ Delirium tremens.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Act. r.]
Sinking or goneness in epigastrium, nausea, internal tremor ; women.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Act. r.]
Periodical colicky pains, > bending double and after stool.
Sharp pain across hypogastrium. θ In uterine affections.
Abdominal muscles sore.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Act. r.]
Frequent, thin, dark, offensive stools. θ Spotted fever.
Alternate diarrhœa and constipation.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Act. r.]
Irritable bladder.
Increased flow of urine makes her feel weak.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Act. r.]
Severe pain in lower part of abdomen, < from motion.
Uterine neuralgia.
Pains in uterine region dart from side to side.
Bearing down as if something was passing out ; > lying down.
Bearing down in uterine region and small of back ; limbs feel heavy, torpid.
Menses : profuse, early ; dark, coagulated blood ; scanty, slightly coagulated ; sharp pains across abdomen, has to double up ; labor-like pains ; debility between periods ; scanty flow between menses.
Menses suppressed : by emotions ; from cold ; from fever.
Menses irregular, delayed or suppressed, with chorea, hysteria, or mental disease.
During menses ; hysterical or epileptic spasms ; increase mental symptoms ; "shivers."
Severe bearing-down pains.
Rheumatic dysmenorrhœa.
Leucorrhœa, with sensation of weight in uterus.
Exhausting menstruation ; with a young girl who was unable to open her eyelids.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Act. r.]
Given during last month, it shortens labor.
Complaints in pregnancy ; nausea : false labor-like pains ; sharp pains across abdomen ; sleeplessness.
Threatened miscarriage, third month ; nervous, anxious.
Labor-pains : severe, tedious or spasmodic, with fainting fits or cramps ; too strong, spasmodic ; feels < from least noise ; ceased for thirty-six hours.
Cardiac neuralgia in parturition.
Convulsions in labor from nervous excitement.
"Shivers," first stage of labor.
After pains, < in groins ; oversensitiveness ; nausea and vomiting.
Lochia, suppressed, by cold or emotions ; watery, mixed with small clots ; suddenly ceased (puerperal fever).
Inframammary pains, < left side.
Burning in mamma.
Rigidity of os uteri in labor (should be taken some weeks before parturition).
Puerperal mania : does not know what is the matter with her head, it feels so strange, talks incoherently, screams, clutches her breast as though in pain, tries to injure herself.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Act. r.]
Tickling in throat, with violent cough.
   

COUGH. [27] [Act. r.]
Night cough, dry, constant, short. θ Incipient tuberculosis.
Cough at every attempt to speak.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Act. r.]
Severe pain in left chest, below fifth or sixth rib.
Tuberculosis, not hereditary, but from exposure.
Sharp pains from side to side.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Act. r.]
Pains from region of heart, all over chest and down left arm ; palpitation ; unconsciousness ; cerebral congestion ; dyspnœa ; face livid ; cold sweat on hands ; numbness of body ; left arm numb and as if bound to side. θ Angina pectoris.
Heart's action ceases suddenly ; impending suffocation.
Pulse weak, irregular, eighty per minute ; feeble in morning, with trembling and weakness.
Quick full pulse. θ Delirium tremens.
Sensation as if a heavy black cloud had settled all over her, and weighed like lead upon her heart. θ Mental disorder.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Act. r.]
Pains about right chest, < from motion, extorting cries. θ Pleurodynia.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Act. r.]
Head and neck retracted. θ Spotted fever.
Rheumatic pains in muscles of neck and back ; feeling of stiffness and contraction.
Stiff neck from cold air, pain from moving even hands.
Sensitiveness of spine, especially in cervical and upper dorsal regions ; soreness of all muscles. θ Spotted fever.
Severe pain in back, down thighs and through hips, with heavy pressing down.
Violent aching in small of back. θ Uterine affections.
Weight and pain in lumbar and sacral regions, sometimes extending all around body.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Act. r.]
Excruciating pains in arms, < as evening approaches. θ Rheumatism.
Left arm feels as if bound to side. θ Chorea.
Constant irregular motions of left arm, which is useless. θ Chorea.
Cold sweat on hands.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Act. r.]
Aching in sacrum, lumbar region and down left leg. θ Sciatica.
Pressure around hips, with pain in sacrum. θ Threatened miscarriage.
Rheumatic pains in joints, with heat and swelling.
Towards evening, soreness, aching and stiffness in region of tendo-achillis ; < walking ; soreness of heels as if bruised.
Dull aching-burning pain in second joint of right great toe, extending up limb.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Act. r.]
Aching in limbs.
Excessive muscular soreness.
Rheumatism affecting bellies of muscles ; cramping, stitching pains.
   

NERVES. [36] [Act. r.]
Nervous shuddering through upper and back part of body.
Twitching of fingers and toes.
Trembling of legs, scarcely able to walk.
Irregular motion of limbs, < left ; legs unsteady. θ Chorea.
Alternate tonic and clonic spasms. θ Spotted fever.
Epilepsy, periodical convulsions, with uterine diseases.
Hysteric spasms.
Restless forenoon : desire to move about, not knowing where to go or what to do.
Nervous uneasiness during afternoon, so uneasy can scarcely fix his attention on any subject.
Paralytic affections.
Limbs cold, twitching, subsultus. θ Puerperal fever.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Act. r.]
Comatose state.
Sleeplessness : with excited brain. θ After nursing the sick. θ During pregnancy. θ Delirium tremens.
Cannot sleep, because she feels numb all over. θ After an abortion.
Unpleasant dreams of being in trouble or in a sad plight.
After going to bed jerking commences on side on which he lis lying, must change position.
   

FEVER. [40] [Act. r.]
Chilly before and during discharge. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Skin cold and moist. θ Delirium tremens.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Act. r.]
Sharp, lancinating pains in various parts, associated with ovarian or uterine irritation.
General bruised feeling as if sore.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Act. r.]
Affects nerves, especially of muscles. θ Myalgia.
Serous membranes.
Chorea from rheumatic irritation.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Act. r.]
Surface sensitive.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Act. r.]
Nervousness from anxiety or overexertion.
Rheumatic persons.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Act. r.]
Aconitum relieves sleeplessness.
Cauloph. similar in uterine and rheumatic affections.
